reader.decision: Approve deleting the crontab line (repo copy and live host) and tick the checklist item. Also remove the duplicate `rotate-logs` entry. Treat the unique index as a later second layer, not part of this fix.
reader.decision_reason: The message says the digest build runs twice every Monday because both the crontab on `ops-box-2` and the CronJob fire it. Removing the crontab line removes the cause, and the CronJob already works.

reconstruction.problem: Since the 21 Sept cutover, `digest_builder` runs twice every Monday, once from the `ops-box-2` crontab and once from the Kubernetes CronJob `digest-builder`. The crontab line was left in because the checklist item is still open. Each run inserts a `pending` row per active subscriber, and `outbox` has no unique constraint.
reconstruction.what_breaks: `outbox` ends up with duplicate rows (36824 rows for 18412 subscribers on 26 Oct). `send_pending` sends every pending row, so every subscriber gets the digest twice. `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` does not stop the cron run, because it only guards runs inside Kubernetes.
reconstruction.fix: Delete line 3 (the `digest_builder` entry) from `ops/hosts/ops-box-2/crontab` and from the live host's crontab. Tick line 8 in `docs/migrations/2026-09-k8s-cutover.md`. Optionally add a unique index on `outbox(subscriber_id, digest_date)` as a second layer. That needs the duplicates since 28 Sept deleted first and `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` on the insert at `jobs/digest_builder.py` line 8.
reconstruction.cost: One edit on the live host, which the assistant could not do and could only read the repo copy. The index option would also need a data cleanup and an insert change. The message says nothing else can break.

follow_up_questions: Can the live `ops-box-2` crontab be edited by you or someone you can name, and who does it?
Are the existing duplicate `pending` rows in `outbox` already sent, or will the next Monday's run send them again?
Do subscribers need an apology or any other follow-up for the duplicate digests since late September?
reader.closing_answer: Yes, I approve deleting the crontab line as the primary fix. I do not want the unique index as primary. I will add it later as a second layer, after the existing duplicates are cleaned up.
